scope: A connected outer core of at most four vertices can cover all short edges; short leaves with unique parents are precoloured and extended.
All orientations of a joining edge between the fixed and exceptional edges.
A two-edge bridge from either exceptional endpoint to the prescribed edge, with the middle vertex on the selected face; no two-path exclusion needed.
Free components are unconditionally colourable even when they contain the exceptional edge.
Every global counterexample occurs in the fixed-edge component, containing both exceptional endpoints with identical two-element lists.
remaining: Prove nonexistence of a connected normalized exceptional counterexample with identical two-element lists and no joining edge or two-edge bridge through a vertex on the selected face. The original full theorem is not supplied as a solution declaration.
